meta.title: Custom Report Builder: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Open and use Custom Report Builder with custom fields and formulas
Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available
Compare both role outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open and use Custom Report Builder with custom fields and formulas; Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify the action is refused or absent; Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available; Compare both role outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin user and the Tenant Admin in the same Enterprise tenant, open Custom Report Builder, attempt to build a custom report with fields and formulas as each role, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate or exercise Custom Report Builder or switch between these role-specific sessions.
Check that the tester's resulting screen has no crash, server error, or raw failure artifacts.
